note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`.

personas.name: routine-familial-cancer-panel-consented-complete
personas.description: Well-formed routine oncology referral: strong family history of breast/ovarian cancer, a BRCA gene panel requested (National Genomic Test Directory eligible for familial-cancer), consent and pre-test counselling both documented, every completeness field present — expect usually-appropriate + ok + routine + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Mother and maternal aunt both diagnosed with breast cancer before age 45 — assess eligibility for a hereditary breast/ovarian cancer gene panel.

clinical.clinicalDetails: No personal cancer history. Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry on the maternal side.
clinical.suspectedCondition: Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome
clinical.familyHistory: Mother diagnosed breast cancer age 42; maternal aunt breast cancer age 44; maternal grandmother ovarian cancer age 58.

triage.notes: Patient counselled on implications for cascade testing of relatives.

firedRules.description: Requested gene-panel test meets the National Genomic Test Directory eligibility for "familial-cancer".
Informed consent and pre-test counselling are both documented.
No escalation; triage follows the requested urgency (routine).

personas.name: urgent-prenatal-diagnosis-time-critical-consented
personas.description: Abnormal nuchal translucency on the 12-week scan: prenatal testing on a CVS sample is first-line for prenatal-diagnosis, consent and counselling both documented, and the prenatal specimen type itself auto-escalates triage to urgent with a time-critical decision window regardless of the requested urgency — expect usually-appropriate + ok + urgent (time-critical) + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Nuchal translucency 4.2mm at the 12-week scan, combined screening high risk for trisomy 21 — confirm karyotype/microarray via CVS.

clinical.clinicalDetails: First pregnancy. No other structural anomalies seen on scan.
clinical.familyHistory: No known family history of chromosomal disorders.

triage.notes: Fetal medicine and genetic counselling both seen the same clinic visit.

firedRules.description: Requested prenatal test meets the National Genomic Test Directory eligibility for "prenatal-diagnosis".
Informed consent and pre-test counselling are both documented.
Prenatal request — time-critical; the result is needed within the prenatal decision window.

flags.description: Prenatal request is time-critical; the result is needed within the prenatal decision window.
flags.suggestedAction: Expedite specimen receipt and analysis; confirm the gestational decision deadline with the referrer.

personas.name: predictive-huntingtons-no-counselling-not-met-incomplete
personas.description: Predictive testing requested for a patient with an affected parent with Huntington's disease: predictive/presymptomatic testing is eligible for this indication, but pre-test genetic counselling was never recorded as offered — predictive testing mandatorily requires BOTH documented consent and counselling, so the consent axis is 'not-met' even though consent itself was obtained — and several administrative fields are incomplete — expect usually-appropriate + not-met + reject, completeness below 100.

clinical.clinicalDetails: Asymptomatic; requesting to know her own risk status.
clinical.familyHistory: Father diagnosed with genetically confirmed Huntington's disease at age 50.

triage.notes: Patient requested testing directly from her GP without a genetics clinic referral; onward referral for formal predictive-testing counselling protocol needed before proceeding.

firedRules.description: Requested predictive-presymptomatic test meets the National Genomic Test Directory eligibility for "predictive-family-history".
Predictive / presymptomatic testing requires both documented informed consent and pre-test counselling; one or both are absent.
No escalation; triage follows the requested urgency (routine).

flags.description: Predictive / presymptomatic testing without documented pre-test genetic counselling.
flags.suggestedAction: Arrange pre-test genetic counselling before proceeding; do not process the test until counselling is documented.
